2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned Addl. Standing Counsel for the State.
The prosecution case is that the Petitioner developed a love relationship with the victim and on the assurance of marriage committed repeated sexual intercourse.
Both of them in fact lived as husband and wife in the house of the Petitioner for some time.
Subsequently, the Petitioner resiled from his promise.
It is also stated that the victim became pregnant because of the relationship.

sentences.text: This Court finds from the case record including the 164 statement of the victim produced by learned counsel for the Petitioner that the co-accused person who, stands more or less on the same footing has been enlarged on bail as per order passed by this Court.

6. Having regarding to the above facts, the submissions made, the materials on record, the period of detention in custody and in particular, the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., I am inclined to allow the prayer for bail.

Let the Petitioner be released on bail on such terms and conditions as may be imposed by the Court in seisin over the matter in the aforesaid case including the condition that he shall personally appear before the trial court on each date of posting of the case without seeking representation through counsel.

Further, he shall appear before the I.I.C.
of Lephripada Police Station on every Sunday at 10 A.M. till conclusion of the trial with such fact being certified by the I.I.C. to the concerned court once in every month and he shall // 3 // not terrorize or influence the prosecution witnesses in any manner.
7. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
